name: pi-search-multi
description: Unified web search extension for pi — 11 backends (DuckDuckGo, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Serper, Firecrawl, Marginalia, LangSearch, WebSearchAPI, Perplexity Sonar, SearXNG) with auto-fallback, combine mode, rate limiting, and secure key storage.
